$description: Wake colour tokens. Dark is the default theme; light mirrors every role.
source-note: Brand hues #FF0049 and #DDBEF0 are observed via a public brand registry (Brandfetch). All other values are reconstructed approximations, not official Glance values.

primary.usage: Brand signal. Live dots, active indicators, icons, large display accents. Never body text on light.
primary.note: Observed / reconstructed approximation. Not an official Glance value.

primary-action.usage: Filled primary button with white label (passes 4.5:1).

contrast.guidance: Large text / icons / UI only on background

primary-dark.usage: Pressed state of primary-action; primary text on light surfaces.

contrast.guidance: Decorative / surface only; never text on background

primary-dark.note: Observed / reconstructed approximation. Not an official Glance value.

primary-light.usage: Links and inline emphasis on dark surfaces.
primary-light.note: Observed / reconstructed approximation. Not an official Glance value.

primary-subtle.usage: Tinted ground behind primary badges and selected chips.

contrast.guidance: Decorative / surface only; never text on background

primary-subtle.note: Observed / reconstructed approximation. Not an official Glance value.

iris.usage: Personalisation and AI marks: For You labels, sparkle, 'because you…' lines.
iris.note: Observed / reconstructed approximation. Not an official Glance value.

iris-strong.usage: Iris icons and borders; hover of iris elements.
iris-strong.note: Observed / reconstructed approximation. Not an official Glance value.

iris-subtle.usage: Ground of personalisation chips and AI explanation panels.

contrast.guidance: Decorative / surface only; never text on background

iris-subtle.note: Observed / reconstructed approximation. Not an official Glance value.

stage.usage: Full-bleed media stage and lock-screen ground. Same in both themes.

contrast.guidance: Decorative / surface only; never text on background

stage.note: Observed / reconstructed approximation. Not an official Glance value.

contrast.guidance: Decorative / surface only; never text on background

background.note: Observed / reconstructed approximation. Not an official Glance value.

surface.usage: Cards and grouped content without media.

contrast.guidance: Decorative / surface only; never text on background

surface.note: Observed / reconstructed approximation. Not an official Glance value.

surface-elevated.usage: Sheets, menus, popovers. Light theme pairs it with shadow-2.

contrast.guidance: Decorative / surface only; never text on background

surface-elevated.note: Observed / reconstructed approximation. Not an official Glance value.

contrast.guidance: Decorative / surface only; never text on background

surface-muted.note: Observed / reconstructed approximation. Not an official Glance value.

contrast.guidance: Decorative / surface only; never text on background

border.note: Observed / reconstructed approximation. Not an official Glance value.

divider.usage: Hairline list separators (8% white on dark).

contrast.guidance: Decorative / surface only; never text on background

divider.note: Observed / reconstructed approximation. Not an official Glance value.

text-primary.note: Observed / reconstructed approximation. Not an official Glance value.

text-secondary.note: Observed / reconstructed approximation. Not an official Glance value.

text-tertiary.note: Observed / reconstructed approximation. Not an official Glance value.

text-on-media.usage: Any text placed on imagery, always over a scrim.

text-on-primary.note: Observed / reconstructed approximation. Not an official Glance value.

success.note: Observed / reconstructed approximation. Not an official Glance value.

error.usage: Failures. Orange-red, kept visibly apart from the brand pink-red; always with an icon.

scrim-bottom.usage: Bottom 55% of any media card carrying text.

scrim-top.usage: Top 20% of full-bleed media, under the status bar and chrome.

glass.usage: Floating controls on media, with 20px backdrop blur.

glass-light.usage: Chips and buttons placed directly on imagery.

video-control.usage: Play/pause glyphs and progress fill on video.

video-track.usage: Progress track on video and story bars.

media-ground.usage: Letterbox and loading ground for media.

signal-glow.usage: Glow under the single floating action. Nowhere else.
